name: Generic tribal toolkit

statuses.consider: 备用组件；不会自动进入牌表。
statuses.seed: 只有在显式复制到构筑种子后才作为必留牌。
statuses.candidate: 可供构筑器评分，但仍需人工确认。
statuses.retired: 历史记录；不应进入新的候选池。

selection_policy.builder_contract: 构筑器只消费显式传入的种子或候选池；未选条目始终只作备查。

validation.source: Scryfall cached card data (exact set/collector lookup)

source_queries: f:pioneer game:arena o:"choose a creature type"
f:pioneer game:arena o:"creatures you control of the chosen type"
set/collector exact checks for manually screened tribal support
review_notes: The supplied 17 support cards remain optional reference components; this review adds 20 later-set entries.
The inventory is tribe-agnostic; choose a creature type only when a build explicitly adopts an entry.
Recheck legality, Arena printings, wording, and creature-subtype rules after every series, supplemental product, or rules/card-face change.

update_policy: Update this toolkit after every series, supplemental product, or card-face/rules change before selecting cards for a build.

support_cards.name: Cavern of Souls
support_cards.note: Creature spells of the chosen type are uncounterable and the land fixes creature mana.

support_cards.name: Haunting Voyage
support_cards.note: Late-game mass return for the chosen creature type.

support_cards.name: Rally the Ranks
support_cards.note: Low-cost global pump for the chosen creature type.

support_cards.name: Radiant Destiny
support_cards.note: Anthem with a possible vigilance payoff.

support_cards.name: Arcane Adaptation
support_cards.note: Turns non-tribe permanents into the chosen creature type; blue splash required.

support_cards.name: Reflections of Littjara
support_cards.note: Copies creature spells of the chosen type; five-mana blue card.

support_cards.name: Realmwalker
support_cards.note: Creature-type selection enables top-of-library casting.

support_cards.name: Kolvori, God of Kinship // The Ringhart Crest
support_cards.note: Conditional draw and a mana-producing back face; not necessarily a member of the chosen tribe.

support_cards.name: Metallic Mimic
support_cards.note: Names the chosen type and grows later tribe members.

support_cards.name: Icon of Ancestry
support_cards.note: Names the chosen type for both pump and creature selection.

support_cards.name: Roaming Throne
support_cards.note: Names the chosen type and doubles relevant triggered abilities.

support_cards.name: Vanquisher's Banner
support_cards.note: Names the chosen type for pump and draws on creature casts.

support_cards.name: Unclaimed Territory
support_cards.note: Fixes creature spells of the chosen type.

support_cards.name: Secluded Courtyard
support_cards.note: Fixes creature spells and creature abilities of the chosen type.

support_cards.name: Bloodline Pretender
support_cards.note: Counts as every creature type and grows from later tribe members.

support_cards.name: Pillar of Origins
support_cards.note: Names the chosen type and fixes creature spells.

support_cards.name: Three Tree City
support_cards.note: Names the chosen type and converts a developed board into colored mana.

support_cards.name: Barkform Harvester
support_cards.note: Changeling body with reach and repeatable graveyard card selection.

support_cards.name: Patchwork Banner
support_cards.note: Names a creature type, grants +1/+1, and taps for any color.

support_cards.name: Three Tree Mascot
support_cards.note: Changeling body that provides one mana of any color once each turn.

support_cards.name: Soulstone Sanctuary
support_cards.note: Becomes a vigilant creature with all creature types; entering as a land keeps the slot flexible.

support_cards.name: Bloodline Bidding
support_cards.note: Convoke enables a chosen-type mass return; needs a graveyard and a dense tribe.

support_cards.name: Changeling Wayfinder
support_cards.note: Changeling body that finds a basic land to hand on entry.

support_cards.name: Chronicle of Victory
support_cards.note: Four-part payoff: +2/+2, first strike, trample, and draw for chosen-type spells.

support_cards.name: Crib Swap
support_cards.note: Kindred instant with changeling that exiles a creature and leaves a changeling token.

support_cards.name: Gathering Stone
support_cards.note: Reduces chosen-type spell costs and checks the top card each upkeep.

support_cards.name: Selfless Safewright
support_cards.note: Convoke creature that grants the chosen type hexproof and indestructible for a turn.

support_cards.name: Stalactite Dagger
support_cards.note: Creates a changeling token and turns the equipped creature into every creature type.

support_cards.name: Door of Destinies
support_cards.note: Grows from casting the named type; slow when played without enough tribal spell density.

support_cards.name: Firdoch Core
support_cards.note: Changeling artifact that taps for any color and can become a creature later.

support_cards.name: Graveshifter
support_cards.note: Changeling creature that returns a creature card from the graveyard to hand.

support_cards.name: Unbury
support_cards.note: Flexible single-card or shared-type graveyard recovery.

support_cards.name: Winnowing
support_cards.note: Convoke rewards a concentrated tribe while clearing creatures that do not share its type.

support_cards.name: Secret Tunnel
support_cards.note: Makes two creatures that share a type unblockable; requires two suitable attackers.

support_cards.name: White Lotus Tile
support_cards.note: Scales mana production with the largest creature-type group, but enters tapped.

support_cards.name: Orcrist, Goblin-cleaver
support_cards.note: Combat damage creates Treasures based on creatures sharing a chosen type.

support_cards.name: An Unexpected Party // At the Door
support_cards.note: The enchantment face grants +2/+2 to the chosen type; the Adventure face creates Dwarf tokens first.

selection.mtga_import_semantics: One copy of every reference entry for direct MTGA import; this is an inventory preview, not a final deck or mandatory seed.
selection.rule: The builder may select a subset of toolkit entries; unselected entries remain reference-only.
